name: Database
description: Scoped, audited database access. Connections name an endpoint; scopes grant schemas, tables, columns, row filters and capability tiers to named principals. The database role, not the prompt, is what cannot write; reads run in a read-only transaction with row, byte and time caps, and every call is audited without bound values.

settings.label: Default row cap
settings.description: Rows returned before a result is truncated. A scope may lower this, never raise it.

settings.label: Default payload cap (bytes)
settings.description: Shaped JSON bytes before the result is truncated.

settings.label: Default statement timeout (ms)
settings.description: Server-side timeout where the engine supports one, plus a PHP-side deadline on every engine.

settings.label: Default per-cell cap (bytes)
settings.description: A single value longer than this is truncated with a marker instead of failing the call.

settings.label: Enable the two-phase write path
settings.description: Registers db_propose_write and db_apply_write. A scope must also grant propose_write/apply_write and a non-zero max_affected_rows, and a human must approve each proposal.
